Three Killed in Kochi After Mini Cooper Rams Scooter

Three 21-year-old individuals, identified as Devika, Gopika, and Ijaz, were killed when a Mini Cooper car collided with their scooter near Kochi airport in Ernakulam district. The deceased were part-time salespersons returning to duty. The driver of the Mini Cooper, Suhail Sajeev, has been taken into custody. Reports indicate the driver admitted to consuming beer, and blood samples were taken for testing. The car was reportedly a birthday gift to the driver.
